The `test_from_2d_ndarray_with_dtype` is failing because the DataFrame constructor in pandas is expecting an index when all values are scalar. In this test case, a 2D NumPy array with datetime64 data type is passed without providing an explicit index. The code snippet of the `__init__` method for DataFrame shows that if data is a 2D array and neither `index` nor `columns` are provided, it raises a ValueError with the message "If using all scalar values, you must pass an index". This error message matches the one in the test failure.

Conclusion: The test `test_from_2d_ndarray_with_dtype` checks whether a DataFrame can be created from a 2D NumPy array with datetime64 data type. However, the test fails because the constructor expects an explicit index when all values are scalar, which is not provided in this case.

To fix this issue:

```
pandas.core.frame.DataFrame.__init__(Args)
```
